title: What I Never Said
summary: Rogue asks V to meet her at three in the morning in a Little China laundromat and says what she never said to Johnny while the machines turn.

start.bringUp: You want to meet V at three in the morning, somewhere nobody knows who you are, and you will not say why on the phone. Bring up, briefly and in your own way, that you need V to come to you tonight.

laundromat.name: the all-night laundromat in Little China

R6.open.01.text: Three a.m. The laundromat in Little China. Bring nothing.

R6.open.02.text: I've got the soap. And something I need to say.

R6.open.03.text: You know who else will be listening. That's the point.

R6.stage.spin.01.text: Sit. I fold while I talk. It keeps my hands honest.

R6.stage.spin.02.text: I know you're in there, Johnny. Don't answer yet.

R6.stage.spin.03.text: I wasn't angry about the tower. I was angry you didn't tell me what it would cost.

R6.stage.spin.04.text: I've not forgiven you. I've not stopped either. Both are true.

R6.stage.spin.05.text: I do my own washing. Always have. It's the only honest chore I've got.

R6.stage.spin.06.text: He made me laugh once. Years ago. Over something stupid. I never told him.

R6.stage.reply.01.text: He said that? ... Tell him I know the difference between him and what he did.

R6.stage.reply.02.text: You keep it, then. That's decent. Thank you.

R6.stage.reply.03.text: You don't have to protect me, V. ... But thanks.

R6.stage.walkout.01.text: Come on. I'll walk you to the corner. I don't drive tonight.

R6.close.01.text: He'd have liked that. Don't tell him I said so.

R6.close.02.text: Hard. Fair. He'd have said the same to himself.

R6.close.03.text: Good. Because I'd hate to lose you.

R6.close.05.text: Go home, V. Get some sleep. And thank you.

R6.bark.fold.a.text: Don't just sit. Hand me that. No, the other one.

R6.bark.fold.b.text: Folding keeps my hands quiet. Try it sometime.

g1.asks: Can you come? And if he has something to say, let him say it later.
g1.know: The meeting is at an all-night laundromat in Little China at three in the morning. Johnny is in V's head and will hear everything.
g1.secret: What you want to say to Johnny.

g2.asks: Does he say anything? Tell me, V. Even if it's rude.
g2.know: Johnny can answer privately, in V's ear only. V decides whether to relay what he said, keep it or let it lie. Nothing in the pack states what Johnny says.
g2.secret: That you want him to say sorry, and do not expect it.
g2.wants: V to be honest about whether he spoke.

g3.asks: What would you say to him, if you could say anything and he'd listen? Say it to me instead.
g3.know: V carries Johnny, the laundromat is quiet, and you are aging and honest tonight.
g3.secret: You are afraid of what the answer would be.

g4.asks: Do you ever wish you'd never met either of us?
g4.know: The walk to the corner, your bag, and whatever Johnny said was either relayed or kept.
g4.secret: You are grateful to V in a way you have no word for.

stages.label: Rogue asks V to meet her at the laundromat at three
stages.know: You have asked V to come to the all-night laundromat in Little China at three in the morning. You bring the soap and something you need to say.
stages.wants: V to come to the laundromat.

stages.label: V sits with Rogue while she folds and talks
stages.know: You fold laundry in the laundromat and talk while the machines turn. You have not forgiven Johnny and have not stopped either. You will ask V what Johnny said.
stages.wants: V to sit with you and be honest about what Johnny said.

stages.label: Rogue talks on after V relays what Johnny said
stages.know: V has relayed what Johnny said. You fold a shirt and say what you have to say, while the laundromat hums.

stages.label: Rogue talks on after V keeps what Johnny said
stages.know: V has kept what Johnny said to himself. You fold a shirt and say what you have to say, while the laundromat hums.

stages.label: Rogue talks on after V lets what Johnny said lie
stages.know: V has let what Johnny said lie. You fold a shirt and say what you have to say, while the laundromat hums.

stages.label: Rogue walks V to the corner after V relayed Johnny's answer
stages.know: You walk V to the corner with your bag and do not drive V. You say one thing about the night.
stages.wants: V to walk with you to the corner.

stages.label: Rogue walks V to the corner after V kept Johnny's answer
stages.know: You walk V to the corner with your bag and do not drive V. You say one thing about the night.
stages.wants: V to walk with you to the corner.

stages.label: Rogue walks V to the corner after V let Johnny's answer lie
stages.know: You walk V to the corner with your bag and do not drive V. You say one thing about the night.
stages.wants: V to walk with you to the corner.

tell.memory: Rogue told you what she never said to Johnny, in a laundromat at three in the morning, and you told her what he said back.
tell.history: Rogue sometimes speaks to V and, a little, past V.

keep.memory: You kept what Johnny said to yourself, and Rogue thanked you for it as a bargain.

lie.memory: You let it lie, and she did not ask again.

stood-up.memory: You did not come to the laundromat, and Rogue folded her last shirt alone.
